summary: Slice 8 Redis realtime broker swap validated end-to-end. Contract parity (14/14), full WS suite (12/12), cross-process fan-out (<1ms), graceful degradation on Redis down, and InProc fallback via env-toggle all pass. Regression smoke tests (admin login/withdrawals, driver OTP) OK.
critical_code_review_comments: realtime module cleanly abstracted behind Protocol; both InProc and Redis backends selected via env + 2s PING probe as spec'd.
Backend startup logs the chosen backend explicitly (`realtime.pubsub redis backend ready` / `baked.startup realtime backend=redis`) — good observability.

Graceful degradation verified: with Redis down, REST endpoints return normal codes (200/404/401, no 500s) and WS auth-guards still fire (7/7 AuthGuards tests pass). REST poll fallback path preserved as documented.
When REDIS_URL is unset, backend cleanly falls back to InProc — env-gated selection works as specified.

Redis pub/sub is fire-and-forget so a `publish()` while no subscribers exist is truly a no-op (contract test confirms this). Note: this also means historical frames are not replayed to late subscribers — matches spec (`hello` frame from customer join comes from server logic, not from broker replay).

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin and generated ephemeral pubsub channels for cross-process test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redis realtime broker is live via supervisor at 127.0.0.1:6379 (pubsub-only, no persistence). Backend chooses Redis when REDIS_URL is set AND ping succeeds within 2s, else InProc. Contract tests at test_pubsub_contract.py cover both backends (14 pytest ids). test_realtime_ws.py exercises the live redis-backed broker. test_redis_cross_process.py verifies two-process fan-out via redis.asyncio directly. Graceful degradation confirmed: REST + WS auth-guards continue to work when Redis is down; only broadcast fan-out inside the WS handler degrades (client falls back to REST poll). All Slice-7 auth guards still return 4401/4403/4404/4409 close codes via accept-then-close pattern.
